name: @oaverify/yaml
description: YAML readers for @oaverify/core: load hand-authored .yaml/.yml OpenAPI specs from disk or over HTTP, plus a synchronous loadSpecSync.
author: Andrew Houghton <aah@roarmouse.org>

scripts.prepack: node -e "if((process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'').startsWith('npm/'))throw Error('Use pnpm pack: npm pack does not rewrite workspace:* deps.')" && tsup && node ../../scripts/pack-devdeps.mjs strip

//: No prepublishOnly: release.yml runs `pnpm test` from root, then packs with `pnpm pack` and publishes each tarball with `npm publish <tarball>`, which does not run prepublishOnly at all. Per-package publish (`cd packages/<x> && pnpm publish`) is not the supported path; it would skip the test gate.
